_major_labs: A new model counts as a 'major release' only if its OpenRouter id starts with one of these labs.
_minor_tokens: Ids containing any of these words are treated as side models, not major releases.
_min_params_b: Ids that name a parameter count below this (e.g. '-8b') are treated as small side models.
_new_window_days: Only models OpenRouter says were created within this many days can trigger an email.
_suggest_window_days: How far back the private page's 'suggested' list goes.
